newsitem.title: FRANCE: French voters seen favouring incumbent MPs.
newsitem.headline: French voters seen favouring incumbent MPs.

text.p: An opinion poll said on Tuesday most French voters would like their incumbent MP to be re-elected in the forthcoming parliamentary election, a finding seen as a boost for the ruling centre-right.

The Ifop survey, to be published in the daily Liberation on Wednesday, said 51 percent of the 1,001 registered voters questioned backed their outgoing deputy, to 34 percent who hoped he would be defeated.

Prime Minister Alain Juppe's centre-right coalition had a huge majority over the left in the outgoing National Assembly. Most polls expect it will retain control of the assembly in the May 25-June 1 election, but with a sharply reduced majority.
